Commentary: Zimbabwe Squad: Ben Curran, Brian Bennett, Dion Myers, Sikandar Raza(c), Ryan Burl, Wesley Madhavere, Tadiwanashe Marumani(w), Brad Evans, Wellington Masakadza, Newman Nyamhuri, Blessing Muzarabani, Tafadzwa Tsiga, Innocent Kaia, Kundai Matigimu, Graeme Cremer

South Africa Squad: Lhuan-dre Pretorius, Jordan Hermann, Dewald Brevis, Tony de Zorzi, Rubin Hermann, Connor Esterhuizen(w), Eathan Bosch, Duan Jansen, Bjorn Fortuin(c), Prenelan Subrayen, Kwena Maphaka, Andile Simelane, Nqabayomzi Peter, Nqobani Mokoena
Squads:
Brad Evans to Lhuan-dre Pretorius, 1 run, hooked through backward square leg as the bowler goes short

Wellington Masakadza to Lhuan-dre Pretorius, leg byes, FOUR, full and straight outside off, Lhuan-dre Pretorius goes down on his knee to play the reverse sweep, gets an under-edge as the ball nutmegs the keeper and finds the fence. Oh, the umpire reckons it flicked the pads
Wellington Masakadza to Lhuan-dre Pretorius, SIX, slogswept! Goes down on his knee and nails this over deep mid-wicket for a flat six
Wellington Masakadza to Lhuan-dre Pretorius, no run, nudged towards the on-side

Wellington Masakadza to Lhuan-dre Pretorius, 1 run, dropped! They have put down a regulation chance. Was a tossed up delivery by the spinner, and Lhuan-dre Pretorius was down on his knee to play another slog. Gets a thick top edge towards short third man, and the fielder stationed there puts it down. Expected to take such easy catches at this level
Wellington Masakadza to Dewald Brevis, no run, played towards the off-side
Wellington Masakadza to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, width on offer outside off, slashed through the off-side for a single. 100 up for South Africa

Kundai Matigimu to Dewald Brevis, SIX, no-look shot by Dewald Brevis! On a length around middle and leg, Dewald Brevis stands tall, keeps his head down and launches it over long-on as the wind takes it over the boundary
Kundai Matigimu to Dewald Brevis, SIX, similar no-look shot, just that this has gone farther! Same length, Dewald Brevis keeps his head down and swings it over wide long-on for a towering six again

Kundai Matigimu to Dewald Brevis, FOUR, 50-run stand up! Pitched up by the bowler outside off, and Dewald Brevis drills it towards wide long-off. The fielder in the deep puts in a dive, but fails to stop the boundary. 18 from the over
